body:
Task T2 is yours once Engineer completes T1.
Goal: Run migrate_config.py on the real config.ini and verify app.py returns the exact same values as before the change.
Key instructions:
- Compare against the pre-migration values without using git stash (inspect git HEAD / history).
- Do not modify files you do not own.
- When verified, approve each deliverable file (migrate_config.py, app.py, tests/test_migration.py) using:
  hermes-crew board approve <file> '<what was checked>'
- Once all approvals are in and everything passes, mark T2 as done with:
  hermes-crew task done T2
